channels.name: MDI pair (TRD)
channels.purpose: The single balanced twisted pair carrying simultaneous-bidirectional PAM3 symbols.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Echo-cancelled bidirectional
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Local TX + remote TX coexist on the one pair; echo canceller recovers remote.

logical_signaling_levels.name: EEE LPI refresh
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Low-power-idle refresh symbol keeping echo/equaliser coefficients valid.

global_signals.name: REFCLK
global_signals.purpose: Reference clock (master sources the symbol clock).

dependency_graph.common_rule: MAC -> RS (optionally PLCA RS) -> PCS (scramble + ternary code) -> PMA (echo cancel + equalise + master/slave timing) -> PMD/MDI (PAM3 on one pair).
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Frame TX/RX requires master/slave timing lock + echo-canceller/equaliser convergence (MSE below threshold) + PCS lock.

handshake_pairs.name: Master/slave timing
handshake_pairs.rule: Slave loop-times to master; roles must be opposite.

handshake_pairs.name: Link training
handshake_pairs.rule: Echo canceller + equaliser converge until MSE below threshold.

handshake_pairs.name: PLCA transmit opportunity (10BASE-T1S)
handshake_pairs.rule: Beacon then per-node-ID TO; yield if nothing to send.

handshake_pairs.name: MDIO Clause-45
handshake_pairs.rule: Address cycle then data cycle on the same DEVAD.

ordering_rules.bit_order_within_byte: LSB-first on the MAC service interface; FCS appended MSB-byte-first (UNCHANGED from base 802.3).
ordering_rules.multidrop_order: PLCA serialises multidrop access in node-ID order (10BASE-T1S).
